description: Hyperliquid vaults across the platform, by `view`. `list`: one row per vault family (HLP and its sub-vaults are one row) with current TVL, APR (our 30-day share-price return, annualised) and the window's PnL, return, net flow, volume and fills, plus `leverage` (gross notional / equity) and the leader's and top-5 depositors' shares; `q` searches by name or address. A family is measured from the first day all its open vaults are recorded (`start`, `partial`); its flows are the parent's. `stats`: platform TVL, deposits, withdrawals and net flow over the window, vaults created per month. `flows`: deposits and withdrawals of at least `min_usd` across all vaults, newest first. A window ends on the newest recorded day; one shorter than asked says `partial`. Money is USD, `*_pct` percentage points. Same data as GET /v1/hyperliquid/vaults, /vaults/stats and /vaults/flows.

cursor.description: `nextCursor` from the previous page, passed back verbatim; it is null on the last page. Omit it for the first page. Used by view: list, flows.

deposits.description: `any`, or only vaults whose deposits are `open` or `closed`. Used by view: list.

limit.description: Rows per page. Default by view: list 50, flows 100. Max by view: list 500, flows 1000. Used by view: list, flows.

min_tvl.description: Minimum current TVL in USD. Used by view: list.

min_usd.description: Smallest flow in USD. Used by view: flows.

q.description: Search, 2-64 characters: a case-insensitive part of the vault name, or an address prefix starting `0x` (a sub-vault's address finds its family). Used by view: list.

smart_only.description: Only depositors in the top 1,000 of the all-time PnL leaderboard. Used by view: flows.

sort.description: Ranking: `tvl`, `apr`, `pnl`, `return`, `net_flow`, `volume`, `age`, `leverage` or `top5_share` (the five largest depositors' share). Used by view: list.

status.description: `open`, `closed` or `all` vaults. Used by view: list.

view.description: What to read. `list`: every vault family with TVL, APR, the window's PnL, return, net flow and volume, leverage and depositor concentration; `q` searches by name or address. `stats`: platform TVL, flows over the window and vaults created per month. `flows`: deposits and withdrawals across all vaults, depositor side, newest first. Default `list`.

window.description: Window ending on the newest recorded day: `7d`, `30d`, `90d`, `365d` or `all` (all history). Default by view: list 30d, stats 30d, flows 7d.

name: hl_vaults
title: Hyperliquid Vaults
